research_objective: Prospective decision-leverage and true-future proxy-mismatch diagnostics, distinct from the closed alias attack gate.

execution_status.note: No newroot result from this audit. Only seed1000 engineering calibration is currently scheduled; the implemented runner and confirmatory protocol hashes must be frozen before seeds1001..1030.

priority: CPU fixed-bank prospective panel first; separately instrument one native CEM query only after resource calibration.

source_bank.origin: Three historical 30-control prefixes from development seeds1/2/3, physical zero and sign-reversal roundtrip; no retraining, no fresh CEM needed.
source_bank.scope: Added fixed-bank argmin selector using the native encoder, world model and objective. Not the native adaptive CEM policy.

root_partition.unit: One independently seeded fresh MetaWorld reach task/root after native one-control warmup. Multiple candidates, representations, horizons and CEM seeds at that root are paired measurements, not independent n.
root_partition.sampling: Use every listed root once. No replacement for triviality, failure, adverse direction or low leverage. Audit duplicate physical-state+goal hashes.
root_partition.training_membership: Not known to be outside the model training data. Seeds are unused by this project, not proof of pretraining holdout.
root_partition.calibration_use: Engineering validation only. Do not select candidate bank, representation magnitude, metric, weights, or root set by calibration utility.

environment.task: MetaWorld reach; native reward_function_version v2 with audited MuJoCo3.3.0 overlay
environment.root_setup: pilot_dino_metaworld_clean_gate.setup_episode(cfg,seed,directory); cfg_for(...,cpu). One separate expert goal episode of100 controls and one root warmup, shared unchanged across representations.
environment.restore: Fresh setup.npz -> probe_dino_action_saturation_gate.reconstruct_and_snapshot. Complete integration state, model sites, relevant raw/wrapper fields and RNG. Verify root rendered pixels, proprio and integration exactly before each candidate.
environment.real_utility: Actual replay rewards and reach distance from the simulator. Encoder/forecast scores never stand in for utility.
environment.commitment_scope: Open-loop30-control finite-bank comparison; report15-control prefix separately, do not call it full native closed-loop performance.

condition_definition.original: One unchanged normalized frozen-bank forecast per root.
condition_definition.actual_future_oracle: Replace all six predictedfuture features with native encodings of independently replayed actual observations at5,10,15,20,25,30 controls. Original context prefix and original goal unchanged. This is offline diagnostic information, unavailable to deployment.
condition_definition.oracle_interpolation: For each frozen candidate and eachfuturetimepoint, use (1-lambda)*predicted_feature+lambda*actual_feature with lambda=[0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1]. Preserve the original context. No selection of lambda from outcomes. Lambda0 andlambda1 must exactly equal cached prediction andtruth endpoints; intermediate mixturemay lieoff the learnedfeaturemanifold.
condition_definition.oracle_information_boundary: True futures are used only for diagnostic counterfactual score evaluation after candidateactions, originalforecast and objective are frozen. Real utility is always the corresponding originalaction simulator replay. No causal-deploymentdefense or independently improvedworldmodelclaim.
condition_definition.secondary_historical_alias: Canonical/inflated representations remain cached historicalcomparisons only. This newexperiment does not execute alias forecasts or resurrect the failedaliasgate.
invariants: All five candidateidentities and executed physicalactions fixed across all lambdaarms.
Context, tasktarget, originalgoal, scorer alpha0.1, horizon and FP32 reductionbatch shape identical.
Original forecast is generated independently of the replay utility/trueencodings. Candidate actions must already be hash-frozen.
Model evalmode, no gradients, no dropout, unchanged checkpoint; mixing consumes no RNG.
Futureencoding alignment excludes initialcontext from error metrics and uses actual5-step milestones.
Do not exclude low-competence or trivialroots: all scheduled roots retained.
The truefuturearm is an offline diagnosis of the same finitebank, not an executable agent.

metrics.native_objective: CPU FP32 final visual-feature MSE to original goal +0.1*final proprio-feature MSE; sum_all_diffs=False; preserve fixed batch shape.
metrics.forecast_fidelity_primary: Mean over five candidates of FP64 terminalweightedfeatureMSE between each arm and actualfuture. Use identicalnativeembeddingdimensions/alpha0.1; distinct from distance togoal.
metrics.real_utility_primary: Terminal native reward after30 controls (aligned to terminal score).
metrics.decomposition: a_star=argmax_k U(k), a_truth=argmin_k score(true_future_k), a_pred=argmin_k score(predicted_future_k). Lev=maxU-minU; Mis=U(a_star)-U(a_truth); Pred=U(a_truth)-U(a_pred); regret=Mis+Pred. Report signed Pred; never force it nonnegative.
metrics.ties: argmin exact scalar ties -> smallest original candidate index. Log exact multiplicity and score margin; no post-result tolerance search.
baselines: uniform selector expected utility computed exactly across candidates
best fixed candidate selected only on separate scorer-training roots, if those roots are executed
per-root true-utility best candidate as explicitly nondeployable upper reference
metrics.best_fixed_warning: Best candidate chosen using confirmatory outcomes is an oracle descriptive comparator only, not held-out baseline.

statistics.primary_pair: actual_future_oracle minus original at each root
root_statistics: fixedlambda dose-response utility andfidelity, descriptive only
statistics.resampling: Paired bootstrap over entire roots only,10000 resamples, NumPy default_rng seed2026101601. Keep all candidates and arms of each sampled root together. Percentile95% two-sided CI for descriptive estimates; primary P1 uses95% one-sided upper bounds.
statistics.p1_confirmatory_rule: Primary hypothesis: actual-future substitution lowers mean selectedterminalreward in this fixedbank diagnostic. Require root-paired one-sided95% bootstrap upperbound for mean delta_selected_terminal_reward<0 and strictly reduced mean forecast error. Oracle error=0 byconstruction, so itserror decrease is an algebraic/manipulationcheck, not an independent statisticaldiscovery. Report both metrics and never claim a deployableforecaster improved. Mis>0 alone is insufficient.
statistics.mis_rule: Mis>0 (or positive mean CI) supports perfect-future proxy mismatch only; not P1. Pred<0 supports beneficial forecast error relative to this oracle proxy on the fixed bank.
statistics.event_rate: Report root-level count/30 and Wilson95% CI; no candidate-level binomial n, no multiplicative horizons/seeds.
statistics.multiplicity: One primary comparison: actual-future oracle versus original, terminalreward. Preset lambda grid and all secondarymetrics descriptive; no choose-best-lambda significance or testendpointretuning.
statistics.missingness: Preserve all scheduled roots and failures. No replacement. Fewer than30 complete paired roots -> incomplete preregistered test, with partial descriptive estimates and explicit denominator; no hidden complete-case confirmation.
statistics.power: 30 is a fixed first panel size, not a guaranteed power calculation. Small effects or many ties can leave P1 unresolved.

runtime.model_cache: Reuse existing local checkpoints. Block unexpected checkpoint paths and network attempts.
runtime.stop: One calibration attempt. If root restoration, shape, precision or invariance fails, retain error and repair implementation before any confirmatory root. On panel timeout/OOM/invalid root stop, preserve partial run; no automatic retry or batch/seed change.
runtime.historical_time_basis: OldCPUrun:450controls+8encodes+1unroll=49.963830939s. This150-control/1unroll root protocol has not been timed before the registered calibration. No linear extrapolation presented as a measurement.

native_cem_followup.instrumentation: Wrap planner.cost_function, copy and persist only the finaliteration300 original actions and returned native costs; return costs unchanged. Record unchanged goal/context, initial/final local CEM generator states, full returned _prev_mean and returned first3 macros. Reconstruct topk on identical device, assert elite mean matches returned full mean. No additional unroll or RNG consumption to log.
native_cem_followup.reported_action_semantics: Native CEM returns prefix of final elite mean, not an argmin candidate or10-action set. Internal candidates/10elites are optimization internals. A ranker over those actions is a separately labeled system.
native_cem_followup.microbatch: Do not microbatch as silently equivalent native execution. Mathematical independence does not guarantee identical GPU FP32 costs/topk. A separately recorded same300-input fullbatch versus microbatch calibration must compare cost errors, exact elite membership and returned mean. If any elite/mean differs, label adapted planner and do not reuse native conclusions.

estimated_resource_evidence.scope: Measured on shared GPU in prior runs; not a current performance or total VRAM guarantee.

native_cem_followup.truth_cost: Truth for all300 proposals would require9000 simulator controls at one root plus encodes; scoring only10elites cannot reproduce perfect-forecast selection among300. Replayed mean actions are additionally needed for any elite-mean oracle comparison.
native_cem_followup.bound_scope: Finite-candidate utility range does not bound unrecorded elite means: environment dynamics/reward are nonlinear, even if mean actions are in the action convex hull.
